title: CakeView
description: The Cake view model of the console, in the public vocabulary of docs/autonomous-demo/cake-runtime-contract.md (resident, capsule, Plan, slot, generation, epoch, transaction, preview, rollback). View models only: this is not a Cake ABI and it mirrors, never defines, what the resident reports.

synthetic.description: true when the object was not read from a resident. Everything Cake is synthetic today, and says so.

ladder_rung.title: CakeLadderRung
ladder_rung.description: One rung: value null means not determined; evidence states what the value rests on.

ladder.title: CakeLadder
ladder.description: The integration ladder, lowest rung first. Each rung is claimed separately and a higher rung never implies a lower one was checked.

synthetic.description: true when the object was not read from a resident. Everything Cake is synthetic today, and says so.

slot.title: CakeSlot
slot.description: One named slot of the resident's graph.

synthetic.description: true when the object was not read from a resident. Everything Cake is synthetic today, and says so.

lifecycle_state.description: A token reported by the resident, passed through verbatim. Deliberately not an enum: the resident's own interface is authoritative and this contract does not invent its vocabulary.

native_event.title: CakeNativeEvent
native_event.description: One event as the resident reported it.

code.description: A token reported by the resident, passed through verbatim. Deliberately not an enum: the resident's own interface is authoritative and this contract does not invent its vocabulary.

transaction.title: CakeTransaction
transaction.description: One update or rollback transaction. A rollback is itself a forward transaction. committed and durable are separate facts. candidate_digest is an optional extension that ties a transaction to the candidate it carried.

synthetic.description: true when the object was not read from a resident. Everything Cake is synthetic today, and says so.

phase.description: A token reported by the resident, passed through verbatim. Deliberately not an enum: the resident's own interface is authoritative and this contract does not invent its vocabulary.

update_preview.title: CakeUpdatePreview
update_preview.description: What an update would touch, computed before anything moves. A preview is bound to candidate_digest + plan_digest + epoch: it says nothing about any other candidate, Plan or epoch, and a console discards it when any of the three changes.

synthetic.description: true when the object was not read from a resident. Everything Cake is synthetic today, and says so.

expected_interruptions.title: CakeExpectedInterruptions
expected_interruptions.description: Whether the update is expected to interrupt each protected resource. null means not determined.

continuity_source.title: CakeContinuitySource
continuity_source.description: One source a continuity measurement rests on. It must sit OUTSIDE the replaced module: a module cannot testify to its own continuity. The emitter declares that explicitly.

continuity.title: CakeContinuity
continuity.description: What was measured across a transaction. Gaps are maxima in milliseconds, null when not measured. natural_dwell_ms is the pause the mission would have made anyway, so an interruption can be compared with it. sources names at least one source outside the replaced module. transaction_id is an optional extension.
